---
title: "beam"
subtitle: "Benchmark Evaluation and Metrics"
---

beam ranks methods from the score tables of a benchmark. Each performance metric has a [metric card](docs/explanations/cards-and-pipeline.qmd) with its scale type, direction, range and allowed transformations, following [measurement theory](docs/explanations/measurement-theory.md). Methods are ranked with [multi-criteria aggregations](docs/explanations/aggregation-methods.md), and the ranking comes with diagnostics: how much it depends on the weighting, the aggregation and the datasets, whether the methods are separable, and whether one ranking fits all datasets ([method by dataset heterogeneity](docs/explanations/method-by-dataset-heterogeneity.md)).

The metric cards link to STATO, UO, OBI and HuggingFace evaluate terms where one exists. The OWL file, [docs/beam.owl.ttl](docs/beam.owl.ttl), is regenerated from the cards on each release.

## Where to start

- [Quick start](docs/tutorials/quickstart.md). From a CSV to a ranking and an HTML report.
- [How to run from beam.yaml](docs/how-to/run.md#run-from-a-beam.yaml). The declarative beam specification.
- [Install](docs/how-to/install.md) and [run](docs/how-to/run.md) in Python, R, or the CLI.
- [Cards and pipeline](docs/explanations/cards-and-pipeline.qmd). What a metric card encodes and how it is processed.
- [Critical difference](docs/explanations/critical-difference.md). Whether the methods are separable across datasets (Friedman, Nemenyi, Skillings-Mack).

## Worked vignettes

- [Duo 2018 clustering](examples/duo2018/duo2018.qmd): scRNA-seq clustering with 14 methods on 12 datasets.
- [Simulated scenarios](examples/scenarios/scenarios.qmd): checks against a known answer.
- [Transportation modes](examples/transportation/transportation.qmd): an example outside bioinformatics, with missing scores.
- [M4 forecasting](examples/m4/m4.qmd): 25 methods on six frequency bands.
- [OpenProblems batch integration](examples/openproblems/openproblems.qmd): multi-criteria rankings next to the platform's mean of scores, plus a Bradley-Terry tree on 50 spatial datasets.
- [Cross-benchmark meta-analysis](examples/cross_benchmark/cross_benchmark.qmd): five published scRNA-seq integration benchmarks of the same methods.
- [LLM cell type annotation](examples/cell_type_annotation/cell_type_annotation.qmd): GPT-4, GPT-3.5 and other language models next to marker and reference based annotation tools.

HTML reports for four of these comparisons:

- [Duo 2018 clustering](docs/reports/duo2018.html)
- [M4 forecasting](docs/reports/m4.html)
- [OpenProblems batch integration](docs/reports/openproblems_batch_integration.html)
- [LLM cell type annotation](docs/reports/gptcelltype.html)
